author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Not directly, no.

However, you *can* bring alts with you into horde dungeons and raids. You can also share exp in a party if characters are within 25 levels. If it's gear you've already collected on your main char, just disassemble what you don't want for materials or forfeit them to the monument guild.

author: frosmayn
body: You can't share it. Either equip your othersouls or dismantle it is my advice
